description: This file defines the EventStreamDataException class within the Aws\Exception namespace. It represents an exception related to event stream data in the AWS SDK for PHP, extending the RuntimeException and including additional properties for error code and message.

classes.name: EventStreamDataException
classes.description: An exception class for errors encountered during event stream data processing in AWS SDK for PHP.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of EventStreamDataException with an error code and message, and passes the message to the parent RuntimeException.

methods.name: getAwsErrorCode
methods.description: Returns the stored AWS error code.
